name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_parkinson_s_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.

name: patient_has_finding_of_decreased_range_of_shoulder_movement_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a limitation (decreased range) in shoulder movement.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical finding of decreased range of shoulder movement (limitation in shoulder range of motion).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical finding of decreased range of shoulder movement.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a limitation in shoulder range of motion.

name: patient_has_finding_of_decreased_range_of_shoulder_movement_now@@necessary_to_perform_pointing_movements
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the limitation in shoulder range of motion specifically affects the range necessary to perform pointing movements.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's limitation in shoulder range of motion specifically affects the range necessary to perform pointing movements.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's limitation in shoulder range of motion does not affect the range necessary to perform pointing movements.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the limitation affects the range necessary to perform pointing movements.
